neighbours.label: the word right after an existence or placement verb whose subject comes later ('there existed in', 'there emerged in', 'there was played', 'places in their hand')
fire: In those years there existed in the province several small Hebrew schools.
Out of the chaos there emerged in the capital a new class of traders.
On that awful night there was played out such a scene of grief and fear.
The reform places in their hands the tools of their own prosperity.
Long ago there lived in this valley a shepherd and his three daughters.
During the festival there appeared on the stage a troupe of masked dancers.
Elle retrouve dans ses traits certaines caractéristiques de son père.
Then there arose in the city a fierce quarrel between the two guilds.
quiet: In those years several small Hebrew schools were open in the province.
Out of the chaos a new class of traders became rich in the capital.
That awful night was full of grief and fear for everyone on board.
The reform gives them the tools of their own prosperity.
Long ago a shepherd and his three daughters lived happily in this valley.
During the festival a troupe of masked dancers performed on the stage.
Elle trouve que son fils ressemble beaucoup à son père.
Then a fierce quarrel between the two guilds divided the city.

notes: Card: ' in' x9, ' to' x4, ' в' x3 after existed/emerged/retrouve/place/played with a postponed subject. Near misses: the same verbs in ordinary subject-first order, or no such verb.
